svg.title: nxk
svg.desc: nxk. Research for Claude: who would want it, how many, where, and every breakdown. Install it in Claude Code with /plugin install nxk --marketplace albri/nxk. Beside the words, 100 adults in the UK are drawn as lines through their age and work to a sign-up that works only in a smartphone app. It suits 84. The 16 it leaves out are in colour: 8 with no smartphone, in amber, and 8 offline, in green.
